claims.text: cma report rules on whether a figure is traced by what each figure cites. A sum, outflow or count figure must cite lines only when it is non-zero. M1, M4, M5, M10, M15, M16, M26, M27 and M28 must cite lines whenever they have a value, zero included. M13 is a count of quarters with no payment, so it must cite lines only at zero. A derived monthly cell must cite lines whenever it has a value, and any n/a figure or cell must give its reason. A case whose M13 counts missed VAT quarters with no VAT line is traced and exits 0. A zero M26 with no lines, a zero days_overdrawn cell with no lines, and an n/a monthly cell with no note are each named as untraced, and the report exits 1.

claims.text: cma report only reads the case root. It checks the root against git and never calls store.ensure_root. Two runs, one plain and one --json, leave every file's bytes and every path's mode under CMA_HOME unchanged, folders set to 0o755 included.

A case purged or missing its case.yaml after it was listed is reported as refused, and the other cases are still reported, with exit 1. A case root inside a git tree that does not ignore it is refused through _case_errors with exit 2 and no traceback. An unreadable cases folder becomes a CaseStoreError and is refused the same way.

The override log and the case log are read in separate steps. When a corrupt statement makes the overrides unreadable, the row still shows signed_off True from the intact case log. An unreadable override log is reported as overrides not known and leaves the figures' state alone.
ruff passes, compileall passes, the full suite passes and the invariants, dual_run and behavioural tiers pass.

dispositions.finding: major report.py:42: false-positive untraced flag and exit 1 when vat_stagger is set and VAT payments are missed (M13 value >= 1 with no evidence)
dispositions.evidence: M13 is now in ABSENCE_COUNTS, so it must cite lines only when its count is zero, meaning every quarter was paid. test_r50_a_missed_vat_payment_with_no_vat_line_is_traced builds the reviewer's statement and asserts M13 >= 1 with 0 lines, traced True and exit 0. It failed before the fix and passes now.

dispositions.finding: major report.py:31: false-negative traced=True for zero-valued figures and cells that must cite lines, and for n/a monthly cells with no reason
dispositions.evidence: I replaced _nothing_to_cite with two functions, _figure_untraced and _cell_untraced. Derived figures that read lines at any value (M1, M4, M5, M10, M15, M16, M26, M27, M28) and every derived monthly cell must cite lines even at zero, and an n/a cell needs its note. The new tests test_r50_a_zero_valued_derived_figure_with_no_lines_is_untraced (M26 at 0%) and test_r50_a_zero_or_na_monthly_derived_cell_must_cite_or_say_why (days_overdrawn 0, and average_balance n/a without a note) failed before and pass now. M9 is the exception, see notes.

dispositions.finding: major report.py:126: crashes on partial failure or a refused case root, and a chmod while reading
dispositions.evidence: report() checks the root with store.check_not_in_git and builds each case folder path itself, so store.ensure_root and its chmod are no longer called. case_report refuses a folder without case.yaml inside its own handler. An OSError while listing the cases becomes a CaseStoreError. cli report_cases wraps report.report() in _case_errors. The tests for the gone case, the git root and the unchanged modes failed before and pass now.

dispositions.finding: minor tests/test_report.py:1: the read-only claim was not proven by a configured tier
dispositions.evidence: test_r50_report_writes_nothing_and_changes_no_mode is marked contracts. It hashes every file and records every mode under CMA_HOME before and after both report runs. Before the fix it failed because ensure_root reset the modes to 0o700.

dispositions.finding: minor report.py:103: one try block for _overrides and the case log, so signed_off was lost and the row was mixed
dispositions.evidence: The two reads now have separate try blocks, and neither one resets state, traced or reconciled. test_r50_an_unreadable_statement_does_not_hide_the_sign_off corrupts main.csv on a signed case. The row is refused with signed_off True, where it was None before.

notes: M9 (net operating cash flow) is treated like a sum figure: it must cite lines only when it is non-zero. A statement with no operating lines, for example only loan lines and non-trading credits, gives M9 = 0 with an empty evidence list from metrics.compute, so that is a correct, traced figure. Requiring lines from M9 at zero would put back the kind of false positive the first finding describes. The reviewer's list of figures that must cite at zero included M9; this is the one part of that finding I did not follow, and the reason is above. The report still reads the case log twice, once inside case_summary and once for the sign-off check. A concurrent write between the two reads could give a row that mixes two log positions. I left that as it is.
